name: Clarine

attributes.attribute: a name given to the sister of King Arthur
another name that may or may not match Clarine

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Clarine is a heroine of Arthurian legend. A few sources give this name to King Arthur's sister. Writers do not agree on whether she is the same woman who appears in other tales under the name Morgause.

okr.objective: Clarine is presented as the sister of King Arthur in some Arthurian texts.
key_results: Some texts call her the sister of King Arthur.
Scholars are not certain whether she equals Morgause.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
